description: Source file defining the 'ConfigSettings' SwiftUI View component, which manages configuration schema display and editing.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays and manages configuration settings based on a schema.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: Represents a section within the configuration schema, with associated label, help text, and node.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: Represents a subsection within a configuration section, including its path and associated schema node.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: Enumeration used to track which subsection is active in the UI.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts the sections from the schema node based on UI hints and key order.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections of a given section based on schema properties.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Returns the effective schema node, handling 'anyOf'/'oneOf' variants and null schemas.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts schema keys to a human-readable string by replacing underscores/hyphens and capitalizing.
